text:
maria: quick heads-up — ran the kv-lane mapping + prefetch experiment on rtx-a pool this morning, saw ~9% p99 regression for seqlen=2048 when we switched from stripe->lane mapping :thinking_face:
ben: can you paste the perf flame or a diff? any change in throughput or just tail?
maria: throughput steady (+1-2%), but tail moved up. attaching short flame snapshot:
```
flame: host: rtx-a-12
seq=2048, batch=4
old(stripe): p50 18ms p95 42ms p99 68ms
new(lane):  p50 19ms p95 44ms p99 74ms
hotspots: kv_read_kernel (45%), attn_prefetch (22%), memcopy (12%)
```
raj: lane mapping + paged-KV layout can cause non-coalesced global loads if lane->physical page mapping isn't aligned. if prefetch distance too small we can oversubscribe warps and increase head-of-line tail.
dina: i saw something similar with MQA sharding last quarter — small blocks + lane mapping spiked p99 on 1536/2048. had to tune block_size and prefetch distance.
lee: try increasing prefetch distance by 1-2 cache lines and bump block_size from 256->512, also ensure kvcache stripe->lane stride is page-aligned. quick config I used:
```
runtime.kv.layout = "lane"
runtime.kv.block_size = 512
runtime.kv.prefetch_distance = 6  # was 3
```
raj: also check kernel selection path: for seqlen>1024 we should hit the long-seq kernel that expects contiguous kvcache pages. if lane mapping shards across pages we fall back to the slower gather path.
perf-bot: [alert] Regression detected: p99 +9% on model: redwood/llama-13b variant: gqa-mqa-lane-test (compare: 1859500000 -> 1859876543). tags: seqlen=2048, batch=4
ben: can you re-run with nvtx ranges + small perf counters? i want to confirm L2/memory stalls.
maria: re-run queued (job id 26911). also capturing page-table offsets and cudaMemAdvise hints.
dina: fwiw, reducing MQA stride to align with GPU page size helped us. we converted to per-lane page padding: pad_per_lane = 4096.
lee: another quick experiment: fallback to stripe for hot prefixes (seq<256) and lane for long contexts. might be a hybrid routing policy.
maria: plan: 1) run nvtx+metrics, 2) try block_size=512 + prefetch=6, 3) test hybrid routing for mixed seqlens. i'll post results in this thread.
ops-bot: noted rollback lock set on rollout gqa-mqa-lane-test until follow-up is posted.
raj: if we confirm uncoalesced loads, kernel selector should prefer stripe kernel for this pool/seqlen. file an autotune entry so scheduler can learn it.
maria: thanks all — will update in ~45m with nvprof output. :thumbsup:
